get_config.doc: Get current trash expiry configuration. Calls the get_trash_config stored procedure on the YP database and returns the configuration record with last_run_time, ctime, and mtime formatted as ISO 8601 date strings. Returns null for date fields when the corresponding timestamp is 0.

returns.description: Current trash expiry configuration with formatted date fields

expiry_days.description: Number of days after which trashed items are auto-deleted

auto_delete_enabled.description: Whether automatic deletion is enabled. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

last_run_time.description: Unix timestamp of the last time the expiry worker ran

last_run_date.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime of last_run_time, or null when last_run_time is 0

created_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime derived from the ctime field, or null when ctime is 0

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime derived from the mtime field, or null when mtime is 0

errors.message: The get_trash_config stored procedure returned no result
An unexpected server error occurred while retrieving trash configuration

update_config.doc: Update trash expiry configuration. Requires admin permission. Validates expiry_days (must be an integer between 1 and 365) and auto_delete_enabled (must be exactly 0 or 1) before calling the update_trash_config stored procedure. The stored procedure also performs its own validation. Returns the updated configuration with ISO 8601 formatted date fields.

expiry_days.description: Number of days before trashed items are automatically deleted. Must be between 1 and 365 inclusive.

auto_delete_enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic deletion. Must be exactly 0 (disabled) or 1 (enabled).

returns.description: Updated trash expiry configuration with formatted date fields

expiry_days.description: Updated number of days before auto-deletion

last_run_time.description: Unix timestamp of the last expiry worker run

last_run_date.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime of last_run_time, or null when last_run_time is 0

created_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted creation datetime, or null when ctime is 0

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted last-update datetime, or null when mtime is 0

errors.message: expiry_days is not a number or is outside the 1-365 range. Also raised when the stored procedure itself rejects the value.
auto_delete_enabled is not exactly 0 or 1. Also raised when the stored procedure itself rejects the value.
The update_trash_config stored procedure returned no result
An unexpected server error occurred while updating trash configuration

get_stats.doc: Get trash statistics for the admin dashboard. Fetches the global trash configuration, then calls the find_all_expired_trash stored procedure to aggregate expired item counts across all hubs. When called in a hub context, also queries the current hub database for per-user trash totals and expired item counts. Returns a combined result with global config, system-wide aggregates, and optionally the current hub breakdown.

config.description: Current global trash expiry configuration snapshot

last_run_time.description: Unix timestamp of the last expiry worker run

last_run_date.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime of last_run_time, or null when last_run_time is 0

system_wide.description: Aggregate expired trash counts across all hubs in the system

hubs_with_expired.description: Number of hubs that have at least one expired trash item

total_expired_items.description: Total number of expired trash items across all hubs

current_hub.description: Trash breakdown for the current hub and user. Null when not in a hub context or when hub_id equals uid.

total_items.description: Total number of trashed items owned by the current user in this hub

expired_items.description: Number of trashed items that have exceeded the expiry_days threshold

errors.message: The get_trash_config stored procedure returned no result
An unexpected server error occurred while retrieving trash statistics

trigger_expiry.doc: Manually trigger an immediate trash expiry run. Intended for admin use and testing. The current implementation returns a success acknowledgement immediately. Actual signalling to the expiry worker process depends on the server process management configuration.

message.example: Manual expiry run has been triggered

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp at the moment the trigger was acknowledged

errors.message: An unexpected server error occurred while attempting to trigger the expiry run
